verdict.rationale: Docs confirm programmatic wallet creation via REST/SDKs with MPC/passkey-based key custody (no raw private key management), fitting per-customer/per-purpose wallet use cases and Agent Wallets with spending policies. However, evidence lacks explicit detail on deposit-address provisioning per customer, multi-wallet-per-customer patterns, or granular key custody documentation (e.g., recovery, key-share architecture specifics) beyond high-level MPC/passkey mentions. Missing for 10: detailed deposit-address provisioning docs, explicit per-customer wallet architecture examples, and independent/hands-on corroboration of key custody claims.
